snippet.title: Goddess of Victory: Nikke Resident Evil Collaboration Reveal Trailer - Future Games Show gamescom
snippet.description:
During the Future Games Show at gamescom, we learned that Jill Valentine is joining the fight in Goddess of Victory: Nikke. It's part of an official collaboration with Capcom's iconic franchise, Resident Evil. Stay tuned for more updates on the upcoming in-game event.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow
